title: Mainly dry weather expected in most parts of the island today
byline: Except for showers or thundershowers that may occur at a few places in Southern province and Rathnapura district after 2.00 pm, mainly dry weather will prevail over the other areas of the island, today (08), the Department of Meteorology said.

title: Trump tells Britain he does not need its help to win Iran war
byline: President Donald Trump said on Saturday that Britain is giving “serious thought” to sending two aircraft carriers to the Middle East, but added that the U.S. does not need them to win the war with Iran, in the latest clash between the military allies.

title: Rapper-turned-politician Balen Shah’s RSP sweeps Nepal election, set to form govt
byline: Rapper-turned-politician Balendra Shah’s RSP is all set to form the next government in Nepal after securing a sweeping victory in the crucial general election on Saturday, decimating the established parties in the politically-fragile country.

title: President Dissanayake calls for expanding women’s entrepreneurship in digital and green economy
byline: On the occasion of International Women’s Day, President Anura Kumara Dissanayake highlighted that International Women’s Day is an opportunity to recognize the vital role women play in Sri Lanka’s economic, political, social, and cultural development.

title: ‘‘Women are vital social partners’’: PM Harini urges a thriving nation where women lead with dignity
byline: As the world marks International Women’s Day, Sri Lanka’s Prime Minister Dr. Harini Amarasuriya has extended greetings to all women in Sri Lanka and around the world. She highlighted this year’s UN theme, ‘‘Rights. Justice. Action. For ALL Women and Girls...’’

title: Fire breaks out at shop in Maharagama
byline: A fire has reportedly broken out at a shop in Maharagama town.

title: No injuries after explosion reported near U.S. Embassy in Norway, local police say
byline: Norwegian police reported on Sunday an explosion near the U.S. Embassy in the capital Oslo, but said there were no casualties.

title: Two suspects arrested with ‘Ice’ in Kurunegala and Padukka
byline: Two suspects have been arrested by police in separate locations on charges related to the possession of Crystal Methamphetamine (commonly known as ‘Ice’).

title: US denies IRIS Dena was ‘unarmed’, says US forces planned for Sri Lanka’s life-saving support to survivors
byline: The United States Indo-Pacific Command (INDOPACOM) has rejected claims that the Iranian warship ‘IRIS Dena’, which was sunk in a submarine attack near Sri Lankan waters, was unarmed, stating that the vessel was a legitimate military target under the Law of Armed Conflict.

title: Narcotics haul seized from fishing trawler estimated to be worth around Rs. 2.8 billion
byline: The Deputy Minister of Defence, Aruna Jayasekara, stated that the estimated street value of the narcotics haul seized aboard the multi-day fishing trawler intercepted by the Sri Lanka Navy on suspicion of drug trafficking in southern waters is nearly Rs. 2.8 billion.

title: US affirms respect for Sri Lanka’s sovereignty in handling Iranian ship and crew
byline: The U.S. State Department’s Spokesperson has stated that Washington respects Sri Lanka’s sovereignty in handling the situation involving the Iranian warship ‘IRIS Bushehr’ and its crew.

title: Over 102 kg of heroin found aboard fishing trawler seized by Navy in southern seas
byline: Over 102 kilograms of the narcotic substance heroin have been recovered from the intercepted local multi-day fishing trawler that was seized by the Sri Lanka Navy, last night (07), in the deep seas off the southern coast of Sri Lanka.

title: 22 Iranian sailors discharged from hospital, transferred to SLAF’s Koggala base
byline: Twenty-two out of 32 Iranian sailors rescued following the sinking of the Iranian warship ‘IRIS Dena’ have been transferred to the Sri Lanka Air Force (SLAF) base in Koggala after being discharged from the Karapitiya Hospital yesterday (07).

title: Over 1,300 killed and 100,000 displaced as humanitarian toll mounts
byline: The humanitarian crisis within the Islamic Republic has reached a critical stage as the current hostilities persist, with significant casualties and mass displacement reported across the country.

title: Sri Lanka grants one-month free visa to rescued Iranian sailors
byline: The government will grant free visas valid for one month to a group rescued from Iranian vessels, allowing them to remain in the country under humanitarian protection, Minister of Public Security Ananda Wijepala said.

title: Apple’s cheapest ever MacBook unveiled
byline: Apple has unveiled the MacBook Neo, a new entry-level laptop designed to bring the Mac experience to a wider audience with a significantly lower starting price.

title: President pledges to make Sri Lanka the most humane nation in the world
byline: President Anura Kumara Dissanayake says that his vision is to make Sri Lanka a nation recognized by the world for placing humanity above all else.

title: Four Sri Lankans injured in ongoing Middle East Conflict
byline: A total of four Sri Lankans have reportedly been injured due to the ongoing conflicts in the Middle East, the Deputy Minister of Foreign Affairs, Arun Hemachandra stated.

title: Gulf nations report fresh strikes today
byline: Countries across the Persian Gulf reported a new wave of drone and missile strikes on Sunday morning.

title: Over 26,000 individuals subjected to inspection during special police operation
byline: A total of 568 individuals have been arrested on suspicion of being involved in criminal activities and also over illicit liquor and drug-related offenses during a special island-wide operation conducted yesterday (07).

title: War in Middle East ‘should never have happened’, says China’s FM
byline: China’s top diplomat condemned on Sunday (Mar 8) the war in the Middle East, saying it “should never have happened” and calling once again for an immediate end to hostilities.

title: Iran attacks breach international law, Swiss Defence Minister says
byline: The United States and Israel have broken international law with their attacks on Iran, Swiss Defence Minister Martin Pfister said in an interview published on Sunday, the latest European leader to raise concerns about the conflict.

title: Three CEOs appointed to new power sector companies as CEB operations end
byline: Three Chief Executive Officers (CEO) have been appointed to three of the six companies established to replace the Ceylon Electricity Board (CEB), which is currently being dissolved as part of the restructuring of the country’s power sector.

title: Iran close to choosing next supreme leader, says state media
byline: Iran’s Assembly of Experts has more or less decided on the country’s next supreme leader after its longtime ruler Ayatollah Ali Khamenei was killed in a US-Israeli strike.

title: Israeli military warns it will ‘pursue every successor’ of Iran’s Khamenei
byline: Israel’s military has issued a warning to Iran that it will continue pursuing every successor of the country’s deceased supreme leader, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei.

title: Nearly 2,000 people injured in Israel since war began: Health Ministry
byline: Nearly 2,000 people have been evacuated to hospitals since the start of “Operation Roaring Lion,” Israel’s Health Ministry said on Sunday, as the country’s health system remains on high alert while gradually restoring non-urgent services.

title: Coast Guard personnel clean up oil spillage in seas off Hikkaduwa
byline: The Sri Lanka Coast Guard personnel have responded swiftly to clean the oil contaminated beach areas in Hikkaduwa.

title: Two Israeli soldiers killed in Lebanon in Israel’s first military deaths of war
byline: Two Israeli soldiers were killed in southern Lebanon early Sunday morning, according to the Israeli military, marking the country’s first military deaths since the war began.

title: Strikes on US bases a ‘legal act of self-defence’: Iran
byline: Iran’s Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi says Tehran’s attacks on US targets in the Middle East are a response to the war “imposed” by the US and Israel.

title: Nearly 400 people killed in Lebanon since Israel began attacks, health minister says
byline: At least 394 people have been killed in Lebanon since Israel began strikes on the country earlier this week, according to the Lebanese health ministry.

title: Fire at Maharagama shops causes Rs. 40 million loss
byline: A fire that broke out at several shops in Maharagama early this morning (08) has caused an estimated loss of around Rs. 40 million, traders say.

title: Notice on online process to obtain police clearance certificates
byline: The Police Media Division has issued a notice regarding the procedure for obtaining police clearance certificates.

title: Oil patches reported off Southern coast; Samples sent for analysis
byline: Authorities are closely monitoring small oil patches reported along the coastal areas of Hikkaduwa and Dodanduwa, according to the Marine Environment Protection Authority (MEPA).

title: Warm weather advisory issued for several provinces
byline: A warm weather advisory has been issued for residents of the Western, Sabaragamuwa and North-western and in the Vavuniya and Mannar districts.

title: Australia weighing requests for assistance from countries attacked by Iran
byline: Australia’s government said on Sunday it was considering requests to help protect countries attacked by Iran in the widening Middle East conflict, but reiterated it would not take part in any military operations in Iran.

title: Donald Trump says next supreme leader won’t “last long” without his support
byline: President Donald Trump said Sunday that the new supreme leader “is not going to last long” without his approval as Iran prepares to announce a successor to its longtime ruler, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei.

title: UAE tugboat sank in Strait of Hormuz; 3 Indonesians missing
byline: Three Indonesian crew members are missing after the United Arab Emirates-flagged tugboat Musaffah 2 sank in the Strait of Hormuz on Friday (Mar 6), Jakarta’s foreign ministry said in a statement.

title: India beat New Zealand to become first team to win three T20 world titles
byline: India won the T20 World Cup for a record third time with a 96-run victory over New Zealand on Sunday to the delight of more than 100,000 fans at the largest cricket ground in the world.

title: Iran war threatens prolonged hit to global energy markets
byline: The U.S.-Israeli war with Iran could leave consumers and businesses worldwide facing weeks or months of higher fuel prices even if the week-old conflict ends quickly, as suppliers grapple with damaged facilities, disrupted logistics, and elevated risks to shipping.

title: Missile kills Indian and Bangladeshi in central Saudi Arabia
byline: An attack on a residential building in Saudi Arabia has killed at least two people and wounded 12 others, the civil defence agency stated.

title: Pope urges peace, warns about wider Middle East conflict
byline: Pope Leo XIV called for an end to the war in Iran and warned that the conflict could drag more countries in the Middle East into instability.

title: US military tells Iran civilians to stay indoors
byline: US Central Command has urged civilians in Iran to stay inside their homes alleging Iranian forces are using heavily populated areas to launch drones and missiles.
